title: FIRST LEVEL SPELLS - the 20 first level shukenja spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and sohei codes
audit_label: R659 OA first level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round forty-six (capture pp. 112-119): the first level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and sohei-usable markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: FIRST LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 112-119 - the OA first level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read - the 20 first level spell stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes (print pp. 113-119; compressed pp. 58-60); all 20 schools, component sets, casting times and saving throws agree, zero contested stat reads. The compressed renders its inch marks as degree glyphs and stars (recorded as its OCR artifact class) and the print p. 113 augury prose garbles 1% per level as 1 orb per level - prose-only, nothing pinned rides it. The reversible flags agree between the passes (the compressed prints Reversible in the headers); the sohei-usable marks ride the R658 T62 grid, settled the round before. The stat grid pins as a table: 20 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special), reversible and sohei markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions and the Table 63 divination results close in their own rounds. The table tag L1Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
